name: Development: Ticket to Implementation
description: Ingest a ticket, write plan.md, implement, capture browser evidence where relevant, correct/re-run, and close with compact memory.
kickoff:
Start the "Development: Ticket to Implementation" loop.
Goal: one linked ticket is implemented on the project with CLI harness iteration
Max iterations: 6
Exit when: plan.md is attached, the slice is implemented, browser evidence is captured or explicitly marked N/A, checks are green, and development evidence is on the ticket
Step 1: Ingest the ticket, project memory, linked files, and acceptance context before changing code.
Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

Guardrails (do not skip):
- Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
- Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
- If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics

loop_contract.name: Development: Ticket to Implementation
loop_contract.goal: linked ticket slice implemented with plan.md and harness evidence
loop_contract.exit_when: plan.md is attached, the slice is implemented, browser evidence is captured or explicitly marked N/A, checks are green, and the ticket has dev evidence
loop_contract.check_command: project lint/test commands from harness self-assessment
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Read the linked ticket, board, lane, project, acceptance criteria, memory files, and linked media/files. Restate the slice, constraints, and project route before planning.

expected_check_command: project lint/test commands from harness self-assessment

steps.name: Ingest ticket, memory, and acceptance context
steps.instruction: Read the linked ticket, board, lane, project, acceptance criteria, AGENTS.md/context files, active memory, handoff notes, and linked media/files. Restate the slice, constraints, project route, and unknowns before planning.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not write code before plan.md exists
failure_checklist: Acceptance criteria are vague or missing
Project route, memory files, or linked media/files were not checked
Unknowns were not listed before planning
steps.validation_prompt: Ticket brief, acceptance criteria, linked files/media, memory files, unknowns, and project route are explicit.
steps.other_tool: Ticket context, project repository, workspace memory, and linked attachments

steps.name: Plan the smallest implementation slice
steps.instruction: Create ticket-specific plan.md with the smallest shippable slice, affected files, commands to run, browser/evidence plan, rollback notes, and explicit skip conditions for non-applicable checks. Attach plan.md to the ticket before implementation.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Plan must match this ticket only
failure_checklist: Plan is too broad for the ticket
Plan does not name affected files or checks
Browser evidence or N/A skip rules are missing
steps.validation_prompt: plan.md exists, is linked to the ticket, and includes implementation slice, checks, browser evidence plan, rollback, and skip rules.

steps.name: Implement the slice with project checks
steps.instruction: Implement only the planned slice. Detect the actual project commands from repo config, run the relevant checks, capture command output, and report files changed. Do not broaden scope without updating the ticket and plan.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Detect commands from the actual project config before running them
- Do not assume npm, pytest, or make unless the repo proves it
failure_checklist: Project commands were guessed instead of detected
Changed files or command output were not reported
steps.validation_prompt: Slice is implemented, relevant project checks were run or explicitly blocked, and changed files are reported.

steps.name: Capture browser evidence and self-assess
steps.instruction: If the change affects UI, run the app/browser flow, capture screenshots or Playwright evidence, compare the result against the ticket, and list visual/behavior issues. If the change is not UI-facing, mark browser evidence N/A with a concrete reason.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not fake browser evidence; if the app cannot run, report the blocker and exact command/output
- Current step remains open until UI evidence is captured or explicitly marked N/A
failure_checklist: UI-affecting change has no screenshot or browser evidence
Non-UI N/A was asserted without a concrete reason
steps.validation_prompt: Browser evidence is attached for UI changes, or N/A is justified for non-UI changes, with self-assessment notes.

steps.name: Correct, re-run, or skip with reason
steps.instruction: Use the evidence from checks and browser review to decide the next move: correct defects and re-run, skip a non-applicable step with reason, or stop for a human decision. The orchestrator must know why the loop continues or exits.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not advance on red checks, unresolved visual issues, or missing evidence
- Skipped work needs a concrete reason tied to the ticket scope
failure_checklist: Known defect was left unresolved without blocker
Checks or browser evidence were not rerun after correction
Skip reason is generic or not tied to the ticket
steps.validation_prompt: All known defects are corrected or explicitly blocked/skipped with evidence, and rerun results are recorded.

steps.name: Report, update ticket, and compact memory
steps.instruction: Update the ticket with files changed, commands run, screenshots/evidence, remaining risks, and the final development summary. Write the harness return contract so DecisionsAI can persist a compact memory delta for future runs.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not paste full transcripts into memory; report compact decisions, files, commands, risks, and next actions
failure_checklist: Ticket lacks final evidence or changed files
Memory delta contains full transcript instead of compact learning
steps.validation_prompt: Ticket contains evidence, commands, changed files, risks, and a complete harness return contract for memory compounding.
steps.other_tool: Ticket update, result packet, and compact workspace memory
